coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Sixteen attacks run, none landed. One custody anomaly to record: the first dispatch pinned 9228d55b while the subject hashes to 81a195e2. I compared with == rather than by eye, since I misread hex once earlier in this session, and the mismatch is real. But the subject did not move — mode 0444, three consecutive identical re-reads, and the review prompt itself pins 81a195e2, matching the bytes rather than the dispatch; a corrected dispatch then arrived with the same value. So the first pin was stale. Had the prompt agreed with the first dispatch instead, that combination would have indicated a moved subject and I would have objected. Everything else holds: HEAD never left c353b00, file 08 at 3a9442d1 and COORD at b200a953 both matching the draft's pins and unmoved, no D-161 heading, C-D161 unused, DR-103 still OPEN, and all seven cited files reproduce. The recital is faithful to the corrected candidate, which is what mattered most, because the join reached v2 only after Codex rejected a v1 I had cleared. Both of the forced repairs survive into the entry: OD-2 appears in the six-member leftover list and in the later-work item requiring a later MF-6 to name OD-1 alongside OD-2, and V2-A1 is recorded as specified and repaired at schemas.v11 / D-104 rather than leftover, with reconciliation of file 08's historical prose routed to that later MF-6. The one citation worth pressing was 'D-139 L names DR-103 leftover' with three specifics, which is stronger than D-160's claim on the same authority. Searching D-139's COORD entry returned zero mentions of DR-103, which looked like invention — but the entry is a summary, and D-139's adopted turn-2 draft carries under its L node the line 'DR-103: D-013 SATISFIED-refusal; D-106 candidate; no fixture executed.' byte-for-byte. That draft is the adopted subject and its digest is cited in the entry. The citation is exact. Condition 2 stays 4 of 32, condition 4 stays MET at 26 of 26, required-now stays 26, D-013's SATISFIED-refusal is affirmed, ceremony stays with DR-112 and locks stay deferred to DR-111.
